items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord for losses, costs or damages caused by unauthorized parties gaining access through access devices provided to Tenant or other Tenant Parties.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to reimburse Landlord for any losses, costs or damages caused by unauthorized parties who gain access to the Tenant Space or the Building through access cards, keys or other access devices provided to Tenant (or any other Tenant Party) by Landlord.

items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord, as Additional Rent, for additional insurance premiums caused by Tenant's failure to comply with Section 6.1.1.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to reimburse Landlord, as Additional Rent, for any additional insurance premium charged by Landlord’s insurance carrier for any insurance policy to the extent caused by Tenant’s failure to comply with the provisions of this Section 6.1.1.
items.trigger: to the extent caused by Tenant’s failure to comply with the provisions of this Section 6.1.1

items.description: Tenant and all other Tenant Parties must fully comply with the Datacenter Rules and Regulations.
items.span_text: Tenant’s Permitted Use shall be subject to, and Tenant, and all other Tenant Parties, shall comply fully with the Datacenter Rules and Regulations.

items.description: Landlord must promptly notify Tenant in writing after changing the Datacenter Rules and Regulations.
items.span_text: Landlord shall notify Tenant in writing promptly after making any changes to the Datacenter

items.description: Tenant must, at its own cost, take timely action so that Alterations and use of the Tenant Space comply with Applicable Laws throughout the Term.
items.span_text: Tenant, at Tenant’s sole cost and expense, shall timely take all action required to cause all Alterations and Tenant’s (and all other Tenant Parties’) use of the Tenant Space to comply at all times during the Term of this Lease in all respects with all Applicable Laws.

items.description: Tenant must act immediately to bring power consumption in the Premises at or below the Electricity Consumption Threshold when an ECT Overage occurs.
items.span_text: In the event that an ECT Overage occurs, Tenant agrees to take immediate action to cause power consumption in the Premises to be at or below the Electricity Consumption Threshold.
items.trigger: In the event that an ECT Overage occurs

items.description: Tenant's electricity draw from PDU-B must never exceed the 130 kW Sub-ECT.
items.span_text: Tenant hereby agrees that Tenant’s actual electricity consumption which is being drawn from PDU-B shall not at any time exceed as it relates to PDU-B, 130 kW (the “Sub-ECT”).

items.anchor_event: receipt of an ECT Default Notice
items.description: Tenant must remedy a Sub-ECT Overage within 120 hours after receiving an ECT Default Notice, or it is an Event of Default.
items.span_text: Notwithstanding Section 15.1.2.1 of this Lease, below, it shall be deemed to be an Event of Default by Tenant under this Lease if Tenant fails to remedy a Sub-ECT Overage within one hundred twenty (120) hours after its receipt of an ECT Default Notice for such ECT Overage.
items.trigger: if Tenant fails to remedy a Sub-ECT Overage within one hundred twenty (120) hours after its receipt of an ECT Default Notice for such ECT Overage

items.description: Tenant must not place a load on the Premises or Datacenter above the Maximum Structural Load.
items.span_text: Tenant shall not place a load upon the Premises or the Datacenter exceeding the Maximum Structural Load.

items.description: Landlord must provide its Access Control Systems throughout the Term.
items.span_text: Landlord will provide Landlord’s Access Control Systems during the Term of this Lease.

items.description: Landlord must install temperature sensors under the floor of the Tenant Space at either end and in the middle of each cold aisle.
items.span_text: Landlord shall install temperature sensors under the floor of the Tenant Space at either end and in the middle of each cold aisle with the Tenant Space.

items.description: Landlord must use best efforts to make temperature monitoring results available to Tenant throughout the Term.
items.span_text: Landlord shall use its best efforts to make available to Tenant results of the temperature monitoring provided by such sensors throughout the Term of the Lease.

items.description: Landlord must operate the Datacenter in accordance with the Customer Handbook, as modified from time to time, throughout the Term.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees, throughout the Term of the Lease, to operate the Datacenter in accordance with the Digital Realty Trust “Customer Handbook”, Version 2.8 dated December 30, 2011 (“Handbook”), as it may be modified by Landlord from time to time;

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant at least 30 days' prior written notice of modifications to the Handbook.
items.span_text: Landlord shall give Tenant at least thirty (30) days prior written notice of any modifications to the Handbook
